name: SideSheet
title: Components/Overlays/SideSheet
description: The title and close control share the first header row. Optional `headerActions` appear below alongside result navigation; `actions` remains a compatible alias. Optional `footer` actions remain visible outside the scrollable body. Fundamental and Fundamental Floating share the same content and interactions.
purpose: Open record details while preserving the queue behind them.
usage: Header actions align with the title and close button. Footer actions and previous/next navigation support longer review workflows; docked mode is optional.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Optional calls to action below the title row, alongside result navigation.

props.name: position
props.description: One-based position within the current filtered result set.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Allow pointer and keyboard resizing from the left edge on desktop.
